channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: From state champs to life lessons: Documentary aims to inspire today’s student-athletes
item.description: New documentary “Pick Up Your Bed and Walk” revisits Fike High’s 1960s football dynasty, showing how three title runs shaped players’ lives and aims to inspire today’s North Carolina student-athletes.

item.title: For the Love of the City Showcase adjusts on the fly for Saturday's big event, now at Fike
item.description: For the Love of the City hoops showcase shifts to Fike after Hunt’s title-game run, keeping a full slate of boys games, alumni showdowns and a charity watch party for Wilson families.

item.title: Looking for company on Christmas Day? Wilson churches host community luncheon
item.description: Wilson churches unite to host a free community Christmas Day luncheon at First Christian Church, offering food, music and fellowship while seeking volunteers and donations.

item.title: New Elm City officials take office
item.description: Five new town commissioners and a new mayor were sworn into office in Elm City Tuesday night. Outgoing Mayor Tawanda Moore also resigned as town administrator prior to the meeting.

item.title: Area Calendar, Dec. 11-12, 2025
item.description: Area prep sports heat up Dec. 11–12 with Wilson Prep facing Robbinsville for the NCHSAA 1-A football title at Kenan Stadium, plus a packed slate of local basketball and swimming action.

item.title: Find your 'why,' stay strong for life
item.description: E.J. Proctor, a former pro goalkeeper, shares how a touching Christmas ad reshaped her view of fitness, shifting goals from performance and appearance to a deeper “why” of strength, aging well and showing up for others.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Johnny Winborne, Greenfield School
item.description: Greenfield junior guard Johnny Winborne, a 3.7 GPA student and dual-enrollment standout, powered the Knights to two showcase wins with clutch shooting at the Good Guys Versus Cancer event.

item.title: Don’t act as if we didn’t see it
item.description: A retired pastor laments MAGA-era denial and online ugliness, grieves a grandson lost and turns Advent’s hope, peace, joy and love into a plea to find our way back to Jesus.

item.title: Can brain hacks help us have better holiday conversations?
item.description: Neuroscience shows how spotting “amygdala hijacks” and shifting to curiosity can turn tense holiday political arguments into calmer, more meaningful conversations.

item.title: Washington can’t come to the rescue
item.description: North Carolina’s water systems may need $120 billion in upgrades, but Washington is neither willing nor fiscally able to foot most of the bill, leaving state, local and private solutions to fill the gap.
